def h(t):

show = ev.assign(
    event_time=ev.event_time.dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
    wm_before=ev.wm_before.map(h),
    wm_after=ev.wm_after.map(h),
    max_et=ev.max_et.dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
    window=ev.window.dt.strftime("%H:%M"),
    win_fire_arr=ev.win_fire_arr.map(lambda a: "end-of-input" if pd.isna(a) else f"arr {int(a)}"),
)[["arrival","event_id","product_id","event_time","max_et","wm_before","wm_after",

print(f"\nfinal watermark      : {h(ev.wm_after.iloc[-1])}  "
      f"(max event_time {h(ev.max_et.iloc[-1])} - 30s)")
print(f"final WM bound       : events with event_time >= 00:09:10 are still on-time")
print(f"on-time / late       : {(ev.status=='on-time').sum()} / {(ev.status=='LATE').sum()}")
print(f"late vs closed window: {ev.late_for_closed_window.sum()} of {len(ev)}")
